messages:
samira: Quick QA pass on Compliance -> Storage: a few UI/accessibility/copy nits. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/Compliance-Storage jon: please enumerate and i'll pick up the small fixes samira: 1) The panel uses 'TTL' as the row label 1— users in research didn't understand it. Change to 'Retention period' and label the numeric input 'Retention period (days)'. frank: agree, auditors prefer the word 'retention' to appear near the value samira: 2) The 'Permanent' option (no expiry) leaves the days input visible and editable which looks like a bug. Design suggestion: collapse to a compact chip reading 'Permanent (no expiry)' and hide the numeric input from sighted and AT users. Announce change via aria-live. leah: For the announcement use a polite live region:
Retention set to Permanent (no expiry)
. Also remove the input from the tab order when hidden (tabindex=-1 or aria-hidden=true). jon: Implementation note: prefer removing from DOM where feasible, otherwise ensure aria-hidden and tabindex change together. I'll include repro + acceptance steps. samira: 3) Region dropdown is sorted by internal codes. Product asks to sort by org usage first then alphabetical. Add a small hint under the dropdown: 'Region affects data residency and latency' and wire it with aria-describedby. frank: example snippet to implement: Region affects data residency and latency leah: also watch keyboard flow: current tab order jumps from region to the audit link, skipping the retention control. ticket should include a focused keyboard test: region -> retention -> audit filters. audit-bot: [policy] Reminder: audit exports must use UTC timestamps and include header 'timestamp_utc'. See /policies/retention/export-format. samira: UI timestamps should display like '2026-05-20 15:00 UTC' and export filenames standardized to include 'UTC' suffix. jon: 4) KMS badge copy: change from 'Customer key' to 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Add aria-label 'Encryption key: customer-managed (BYOK)'. When multiple keys exist show a 'Key details' link that opens a drawer containing Key ID, created on, and rotation policy. Drawer must be role=dialog, aria-modal=true and move focus to its heading. frank: i'll mock the drawer and final copy. keep headings terse (Key ID, Created, Rotation). disable 'Rotate key' action unless org has permissions. leah: accessibility acceptance criteria: 1) aria-live announces toggle changes, 2) numeric input removed from AT when 'Permanent' selected, 3) focus order test passes, 4) drawer traps focus and returns focus on close. jon: i'll file the frontend ticket today (hiding behavior, aria-live, aria-describedby binding, focus-order repro). ETA tomorrow morning. samira: thanks everyone. tagging @leah for a11y signoff, @frank for KMS copy, @jon for implementation. :white_check_mark:
